units: source pixels; no final logical NUI dimensions verified
textures: Direct RGBA PNG resrefs; no atlas.

outer.assembly: Four corners, left/right/bottom rails, top_l/top_m/top_r. Uniformly scale corners/top_m; stretch straight rails only along their long axis.

portrait.assembly: Eight slices; portrait stays beneath frame filigree, aspect preserved.

dialogue.assembly: Eight slices; reserve pagination inside bottom padding.

controls.assembly: Preserve cap aspect at the chosen height; stretch the middle horizontally. If using the whole bitmap in one NuiImage, preserve its canonical aspect.
controls.text: Live centered labels; More reserves space for a separate arrow.

states.selected: Not applicable to momentary dialogue actions
states.pressed: No texture variant; later matching left press/release gates activation
states.disabled: Native disabled image plus muted overlays and presenter guard; verify in Step 1/2

divider.assembly: Keep center ornament at uniform scale; stretch tail width only.

reused_resources.decision: Reuse: subdued black interlaced texture matches the supplied theme. Stretching is allowed; seamless tiling is not claimed.
Reuse: red/gold X fits the theme; rendering proportions must be checked in Step 1.
Reuse: blank square gold/dark housing; overlay a separate glyph.
Reuse: gold chevron rather than the reference triangle; accepted asset-stage style difference.
Reuse: gold chevron rather than the reference triangle; accepted asset-stage style difference.

rejected_reuse.ui_cdx_div_l: Too heavy; use the new fine divider components.
rejected_reuse.ui_cdx_div_r: Too heavy; use the new fine divider components.

offline_reference_layout.coordinate_origin: Outer reference crop x143 y56; XYWH in source pixels

scope: Assets and offline composition only; NUI implementation, packing, deployment and client review remain later stages.
known_deviations: ImageGen reconstruction is not pixel-exact artwork extraction.
Reused navigation glyphs are chevrons rather than the reference triangles.
Preview font is DejaVu Serif and does not predict the native NUI font.
